categories.name: AI Customer Experience & Personalization
categories.intro: AI-driven ways of discovering, engaging, and retaining customers across channels.

cases.name: Agentic Contextualized Discovery
cases.def: AI-powered systems that autonomously guide shoppers through product discovery by leveraging real-time contextual data (such as user intent, location, behavior, and preferences).

cases.name: AI Generated and Automated Promotion Campaigns
cases.def: Leverage real-time data (e.g., inventory, customer behavior, market trends) to dynamically generate campaign content, select target audiences, determine optimal timing, and adjust offers for maximum impact, across digital and physical channels.

cases.name: Paid Loyalty Programs
cases.def: Customer loyalty schemes that require a recurring fee (e.g., monthly or annual subscription) for membership, in exchange for access to exclusive benefits, enhanced rewards, or premium services.

cases.name: Voice Commerce Devices
cases.def: Voice-enabled hardware and software platforms (e.g., smart speakers, voice assistants on mobile devices, in-car systems, or in-store kiosks) that facilitate product discovery, ordering, and customer service through natural language interaction.

cases.name: AI-driven Conversational Chatbots
cases.def: LLM-driven chatbots handle a range of tasks, from product discovery and personalized recommendations to order management and customer support, delivering scalable, always-on service and driving operational efficiency.

cases.name: Digital Connected Product Experiences
cases.def: Enhance CX and achieve CRM and loyalty program goals (e.g., lifetime value and increased retention) through consistently contextual and relevant interactions leveraging consumer mobile digital screens, supported by a network that processes, mines, and analyzes real- and near-real-time data through the customer journey.

categories.name: AI-Powered Integrated Planning
categories.intro: AI/ML applied to pricing and order orchestration decisions across the enterprise.

cases.name: AI-Driven Dynamic Pricing
cases.def: Software that leverages data to make algorithmic decisions on best price, appropriate markdowns, and promotion optimization to meet margin and revenue goals across enterprise-level retail, using AI/ML to continuously adjust prices in real time based on demand signals, competitive positioning, inventory levels, and other contextual variables.

cases.name: Optimized Order Orchestration
cases.def: Retail order orchestration and fulfillment: automating the steps to process an order, distributing the order to the location from which it should be fulfilled, and managing its delivery to the consumer, optimized at all levels.

categories.name: Marketing, Retail Media & Brand Monetization
categories.intro: Monetizing attention, media, and demand through advertising, social, and influencer channels.

cases.name: Demand Shaping – Offers
cases.def: Adjustment of overall consumer demand through incentives, discounts, placement, price, advertising, or promotion, used to intelligently match existing supply or achieve a strategic business objective. Using AI-optimized pricing and promotions to influence consumer demand and align customer behavior with supply availability and business goals.

cases.name: Social Commerce
cases.def: The integration of social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, WeChat) into the retail customer journey to facilitate shoppable posts, livestream selling, influencer-driven campaigns, and peer-to-peer recommendations, often with embedded checkout and payment capabilities.

cases.name: Influencer Marketing
cases.def: Leverages the human as well as AI influencer's credibility, audience reach, and content creation skills to authentically promote products or experiences, often integrating with social commerce and omnichannel campaigns.

cases.name: Targeted Online Advertising – Retail Media Networks
cases.def: Additional revenue streams based on developed creative and copy tied to brand/CPG-sponsored products based on retailer online traffic and targeted positioning of digital ads.

cases.name: In-Store Digital Advertising – RMN
cases.def: Additional revenue streams based on developed creative and copy tied to brand/CPG-sponsored products based on retailer footfall and targeted positioning of digital ads in automated digital signage.

categories.name: Retail Supply Chain Automation & Fulfillment
categories.intro: Automating inventory, returns, and delivery to move goods faster and more profitably.

cases.name: On-demand Supply Chain / Product Customization as a Service
cases.def: Additional revenue streams based on developed creative and copy tied to brand/CPG-sponsored products based on retailer footfall and targeted positioning of digital ads in automated digital signage.

cases.name: Predictive Network Inventory Orchestration
cases.def: Predictively optimized network inventory orchestrations that optimize the level and location of inventory and inventory depots.

cases.name: Advanced Enterprise Reverse Logistics Execution
cases.def: Advanced returns management systems that enable end-to-end tracking and redistribution of returned goods from consumer to reconciliation, optimizing profitability by recommending the most profitable disposition of goods.

cases.name: Last Mile Same Day Delivery Optimization
cases.def: Route optimization and dynamic dispatch algorithms that minimize delivery time, fuel cost, and labor for same-day last-mile delivery, accounting for SLAs and sustainability factors.

cases.name: Last Mile Same Day Delivery Visibility
cases.def: Real-time tracking and communication tools that provide retailers, pickers, drivers, and customers with end-to-end visibility into same-day delivery status and location.

cases.name: Omnichannel Order Orchestration & Fulfillment
cases.def: Distributed order management systems that intelligently route and fulfill omnichannel orders from the optimal inventory location — DC, store, or third party — based on cost, speed, and availability.

cases.name: Fulfillment-as-a-Service
cases.def: Cloud-based fulfillment platforms offered as a service, enabling retailers — especially smaller operators — to access same-day delivery, ecommerce, and ultrafast fulfillment capabilities without heavy capital investment.
